title: Self-Explaining Hate Speech Detection with Moral Rationales
findings: Religion is included as a protected characteristic for identifying hate speech within the dataset. One example provided in the paper (Table 6) shows hate speech targeting 'Jews'. However, the paper does not provide a specific breakdown of findings or performance metrics related to religion as a distinct category.
